exposure: Inhaled salbutamol (0.15 ml/kg in 2 ml normal saline)
cohort: 80 neonates diagnosed with Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN).
finding: Inhaled salbutamol significantly improved respiratory distress, reduced the duration of tachypnea, hospital stay, oxygen therapy, and shortened the time to initiating enteral feeding in neonates with TTN.
